mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_post_like (user_id, post_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_post_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} and status = 'A'

SELECT post_id, user_id FROM ( SELECT post_id, user_id, -- 按帖子分组，点赞时间倒序，给序号；同post内新点赞排前面 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY post_id ORDER BY create_time DESC) AS rn FROM user_post_like where post_id in #{postId}
) t WHERE rn < 3;
